portInfo.description: Suez sits at the northern end of the Gulf of Suez / southern canal system and appears on MedCruise’s Egyptian Ports list with compact passenger dimensions: maximum length 161 m, draught 7 m, five quays totalling 870 m at 7 m depth, one passenger terminal, tugs and tenders available, city ~3 km, airport ~120 km. The Suez Canal Authority website provides canal-authority context but not a substitute cruise-berth engineering table for the commercial Port of Suez passenger facility. Larger transit ships using the canal are not the same as alongside cruise calls at Suez port — keep those concepts separate.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Cairo day trip — only on long calls (airport ~120 km).
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not confuse canal transit photo ops with a Suez port call itinerary.
